title: Thermodynamics & Kinetics
syllabus: Laws of thermodynamics, entropy, Carnot cycle, free energy and the Gibbs–Helmholtz equation; rate laws, order, integral rate equations, half-life, collision theory, Arrhenius equation and catalysis.

title: Energy Devices
syllabus: Electrochemical and electrolytic cells, semiconductor electrode materials, classes of batteries, Li-ion chemistry, H₂–O₂ and solid oxide fuel cells, silicon photovoltaics, photoelectrochemical and dye-sensitized cells.

title: Functional Materials
syllabus: Electrical materials (Ohm’s law, energy bands, conductors, semiconductors, insulators, superconductors), magnetic materials, nanomaterials (synthesis, bulk vs nano gold, quantum dots) and liquid coolants.

title: Spectroscopy & Diffraction
syllabus: Principle, instrumentation and applications of UV-Visible spectroscopy and powder XRD, crystallite size from XRD, numericals.

title: Computational Chemistry
syllabus: Quantum mechanical calculations, molecular mechanics and dynamics, ab initio, semi-empirical and DFT methods, atomic and molecular orbitals, potential energy surfaces, geometry optimisation, frequencies, reaction mechanisms and AI-driven screening.
